newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Bangert ups Gamma estimates, repeats Sell.
newsitem.headline: Bangert ups Gamma estimates, repeats Sell.

text.p: COMMENT: Sell (unchanged). Good H1 results justify upgrade of EPS estimates but sell recommendation reiterated as Gamma still plagued by market overcapacity in interior products, heavy competition from low cost, low currency countries and slow growth in its markets. Also management board seen understaffed to handle changes company requires.

H1 profit growth helped by restructuring at exotic textiles maker Vlisco and Texoprint. Margins also boosted by Vlisco and lower raw material costs. Gamma sees full-year net up 20 pct on 1995, but 1995 depressed by Dfl 5 million restructuring charge.
* 1995 figure based on year-end share prices
